# `project/v1` — project.md — project metadata

<!-- AUTOGENERATED from `Glorbo.FileSpec.ProjectMd` by
     `mix glorbo.docs.file_formats`. Do not edit by hand;
     regen after changing the spec module. -->

Project metadata sitting at the root of each projects/<slug>/
directory. Slug must be URL-safe kebab-case and must NOT end
in `-<digits>` (parser ambiguity with task IDs — GEP-13).

## Frontmatter schema

**Required:** `kind`, `slug`, `name`

**Optional:** `status`, `description`, `icon`, `created_at`, `goal`

### Enums

| Key | Allowed values |
|-----|----------------|
| `status` | `active`, `paused`, `done`, `archived` |

### Patterns

| Key | Regex |
|-----|-------|
| `slug` | `\A[a-z][a-z0-9-]*(?<!-\d)\z` |


## Canonical key order

When the formatter rewrites this file, keys appear in this order:

`kind`, `slug`, `name`, `status`, `description`, `icon`, `goal`, `created_at`

Unknown keys fall after the known block, sorted alphabetically.

## Examples

```markdown
---
kind: project/v1
slug: release
name: Release engineering
description: Cut + announce Glorbo releases
icon: rocket
---
```
